description: Open Banking Limited publishes the UK Open Banking technical standards and API specifications used by banks and third-party providers. These standards define interfaces for sharing account data, initiating payments, confirming funds, and exposing open banking product and location data.
summary: openbanking.org.uk publishes HTTP API standards/specifications for Open Data, Account and Transaction, Payment Initiation, Confirmation of Funds, and Event Notifications; the read/write APIs use OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens obtained via ASPSP-specific Open Banking registration and authorization flows, while the Open Data API is public.
